courseDescription:
This course introduces students to selected topics from mathematical analysis with engineering
applications. The first part is a calculus part which covers the definition of functions of several variables
and their domain and range. Also, the course discusses limits, continuity, partial derivatives, gradient
vectors, and multiple integrals for functions of several variables. The second part of the course deals
with Fourier analysis including complex numbers, Fourier series, Fourier integrals, and Fourier
transforms.
